annotations.title: Verify a third-party receipt (paid, x402 + EIP-3009)

description: Cryptographic verification of a THIRD-PARTY receipt via the receipt verifier POST /verify (pay-per-call, ~$0.01 USDC on Base, settled with a locally-signed EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization sent as X-Payment). AGP-162 security: the signed 402 challenge (EIP-712 PHANTOM-402, service wallet) is verified BEFORE signing anything — amount/payTo/asset/resource/expiry are checked against the payment-requirements and fail closed on any mismatch (MITM/tampering). Requires PHANTOM_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY. If the 402 carries no challenge, PHANTOM_402_STRICT=true (default) refuses to pay ('servidor sin firma: rehusado'); set it to false only as a controlled transition. For receipts of payments the caller participated in, use the free verify_payment instead.

receipt.description: Signed ReceiptInput to verify (paymentIntentId, payer, recipient, token, amount, platformFee, maximumTotalAuthorized, nonce, expiresAt, signature).
